skill.description: Search and download GIFs from Tenor through a controlled command-line workflow.

memory.responsibility: Retain search phrase plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform tenor search endpoint into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through relevance and content filter while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose source discovery and evidence-processing capabilities that preserve provenance and uncertainty.

stages: Convert intent into concise search terms
Query Tenor with a bounded result count
Inspect previews dimensions and source links

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
